title: Task and history
text: A task instruction and observation history supply the model input.

title: Shared model
text: A frozen vision encoder and a language model with LoRA and prediction heads process the input.

title: Joint predictions
text: The heads predict progress, terminal success, and structured failure diagnostics.

title: Masked training
text: Annotation labels supervise the masked joint loss; uncertain fields are masked independently.

title: Frozen rewards for PPO
text: During PPO the reward model stays frozen; task feedback and failure penalties guide policy updates.
